newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chairmen cut stake in Four Seas Travel.
newsitem.headline: Chairmen cut stake in Four Seas Travel.

text.p: Four Seas Travel International Ltd said on Monday that controlling shareholder Gaware Holdings Ltd sold 4.2 million shares, or 2.34 percent of its existing share capital, to independent third parties on January 22.
Gaware is wholly owned by Four Seas Travel chairman Leung Yeung Lai-ming and vice chairman Leung Hoi. The company gave no details on the price of the share sale.
Gaware's stake in the company was reduced to 113.53 million shares, or 63.20 percent, from 65.54 percent, it said.
The travel services company said its chairman and vice chairman have no immediate plan to dispose of further shares in the company.
Four Seas shares ended HK$0.02 down at HK$1.11 on Monday.
